climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A cru village in the Côte des Blancs, a Champagne sub-region whose vineyards are 95% Chardonnay. Champagne's sparkling wines are made from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Meunier and a few rarer grapes.
